sources.title: Best practices for Claude Code
supporting_claims: Give the agent a way to verify its work with tests, builds, screenshots, or other checks.
Use focused subagents for investigation or verification to keep the main context clean.
Separate exploration, planning, implementation, and verification when the task benefits from it.

sources.title: Create custom subagents
supporting_claims: Give each subagent a specialized purpose and focused responsibility.

sources.title: How OpenAI uses Codex
supporting_claims: Write a task like a well-scoped GitHub issue with relevant files, components, and examples.
Use AGENTS.md to give Codex durable repository guidance.
Use parallel attempts when comparing approaches is valuable.

sources.title: Introducing Codex
supporting_claims: Codex performs better with configured test environments and clear repository instructions.
Users should review and validate generated work before integrating it.
